steps.title: Item count
steps.detail: Every piece is counted and logged with you at the door before it leaves.

steps.title: Separately packed
steps.detail: Each order is bagged on its own — your clothes never share a wash with anyone else's.

steps.title: Acknowledgement
steps.detail: You get a written receipt of exactly what was collected, signed at pickup.
